sections.title: How the Jeevan Umang Calculator Works
sections.description: Here's the logic from the official LIC brochure (UIN: 512N317V02).

content.text:
1. Premium Calculation

I start with LIC's base rates and add 'modal loadings' for accurate monthly/quarterly premiums.

2. Guaranteed Survival Benefit

This is the core feature. The formula is simple: Annual Payout = 8% × Basic Sum Assured. This starts the year after your premium term ends and continues every year until you turn 100.

3. Maturity & Death Benefit

At age 100 (or on death), the payout is: Maturity Value = Sum Assured + Vested Bonuses + FAB. This calculator uses illustrative bonus rates to project this future value for you.

conclusion.title: My Final Take: Is Jeevan Umang Right for You?
conclusion.body: Jeevan Umang is a powerful tool for creating a guaranteed, lifelong income stream, functioning almost like a private pension. If you value certainty and want a disciplined savings plan that provides for you in retirement and leaves a legacy, it is one of LIC's best whole-life offerings.

mainEntity.name: How is guaranteed survival income calculated in Jeevan Umang?

acceptedAnswer.text: The guaranteed survival income is calculated as 8% of the Basic Sum Assured and is paid out annually after the completion of the premium paying term, until the policyholder reaches 100 years of age.
